_comment: Offline trust anchor for composed/v2. Contains only the AgentAvow key: agentgraph-security-v1 is the product's PRODUCTION public key, copied verbatim from https://agentgraph.co/.well-known/jwks.json. The AgentAvow slot signature in this batch verifies against it. APS and AgentID slots are structural (unsigned) in v2; their keys join this JWKS when each co-issuer signs its own slot.
